title: Edge AI Solutions @ WgTech
description: A comprehensive portfolio of production-ready Edge AI solutions for Vision Intelligence, Electrical Analytics, and Privacy-Preserving Radar Sensing.
long_description: The DEEPCRAFT™ based Edge AI Solutions Portfolio offers a range of production-ready AI models designed for deployment on edge devices. Our solutions span computer vision for inspection, detection, and analytics; electrical intelligence for voltage, current, and power anomaly detection; and privacy-preserving radar applications for people counting, occupancy monitoring, and motion sensing. Built to operate efficiently on resource-constrained hardware, these AI solutions enable real-time decision making, improved operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, enhanced safety, and privacy-focused sensing across environments.

videos.title: Entrance Exit Detection - mmWave Radar with PSOC™ 6 AI Model
videos.description: This application demonstrates how to accurately count people entering and exiting a room or designated area using an AI model running on PSOC™ 6 and leveraging Infineon's XENSIV™ 60GHz radar sensor. Optimized for low-power edge devices, it enables real-time people counting for smart buildings, retail stores, offices, and public spaces.
